contract.choice_proof: Only normalized explicit manual choice emits strict own-field marker: origin manual, addOnId Smart, exact resolved catalogReference. No missing/extra fields; no cross-product/version/addon reuse.
contract.repeat: First, second, third enrichment plus JSON roundtrip retain Smart selected ID and three canonical keyed catalog rows, values, complete primary/qualification sources and catalog origin.
contract.deselection: Fresh manual input without Smart removes marker and Smart rows; stale addOnIds/catalog terms cannot resurrect choice.
contract.document_priority: Existing document selected/refused/conflict/explicit unknown takes precedence, preserving values and sources. Supporting terms do not create or override customer choice.
contract.availability: Catalog ID/name/availability, invalid proof, unknown product/provider/type/scope/version or unavailable component cannot activate manual Smart.
contract.other_addons: Only Smart continuation changes; Utleie continuation remains baseline; existing rot rule preserved with Smart+rot retaining both explicit choices.
contract.display: Same scoped resolver governs enrichment and selected addon display. Comparison both directions retains canonical rows and full sources.
contract.price_and_service: No claim of operational alarm activation, unqualified 8 000 reduction or house sum from 100 000 service liability; no premium/deductible modification.
